title: Theory 3.3 constitutive and production limit
question: Does Nulloth recover the Theory 3.3 constitutive and production systems when the scalar vanishes, and do finite scalar-stress corrections disappear quadratically with scalar amplitude?
prediction: All compared constitutive fields and the first 24 production right-hand-side groups agree at zero scalar amplitude, while one-step discrepancies at finite uncoupled scalar amplitude scale with at least order 1.7 as the amplitude is halved.
falsifier: Primitive recovery fails, a compared zero-scalar field differs above the registered tolerance, the state layout changes unexpectedly, or the finite-amplitude one-step error fails to decrease with at least order 1.7.
controls: The unmodified Theory 3.3 constitutive and production implementations are the regression oracles.
All scalar material couplings are disabled in the production comparison.
The finite-amplitude comparison retains canonical scalar stress so convergence, rather than equality, is required.
seed_rationale: The registered periodic profiles and all comparisons are deterministic.
